spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ12 error code registration — arch/errors.md 061 + 066 + 067 yeni entries.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: TemplateRepository.GetByIdAsync PRE-EXISTING (bu pakette kolon listesi refactor sadece, tenant_id parametresi eklenmedi). 3 call-site tamami superadmin-only /api/ops/templates/catalog/{id} proxy (Program.cs L1066/L1097/L1131) — cross-tenant BY DESIGN (superadmin her tenant'in template'ini gorebilir). Tenant-scoped templateleri tuketici akislar /api/v1/templates/{tenantId}/* veya yeni /api/v1/templates/{tenantId}/group/{gt} endpoint'leri uzerinden erisir (JWT validate + tenant match).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Superadmin ops endpoint semantic (plan + template curation)'i korumak. tenant_id parametresi eklemek 3 pre-existing call-site'in davranisini break eder (superadmin cross-tenant goruntuleme ihlal). Scope disi refactor.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ9 false positive for pre-existing GetByIdAsync — tenant isolation korunur cunku (a) superadmin endpoint'i tek caller, (b) yeni FetchByGroupTagAsync method'u tenant_id filter'i WHERE clause'da sabit, (c) ListAsync yeni TenantId filter optional.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Migration 020 leads.faq_rotation_state yeni kolon (tablo ADD COLUMN); ayri GRANT gerekmez. PostgreSQL kolonlar tablonun mevcut GRANT'lerini inherit eder — pkt6b1-niche-business.sql L157'deki 'GRANT ALL ON leads TO invekto_app' yeni kolonu otomatik kapsar.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Migration dosyasinda per-column GRANT REDUNDANT olur. Template 019 (idx_tc_group_tag) icin de ayni mantik: index'ler table GRANT inherit eder, ayri privilege gerekmez.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ11 FP for migration 020 GRANT evidence — new column NOT new table; existing GRANT covers inherited privileges.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Yeni /api/v1/templates/{tid}/group/{gt} endpoint FetchByGroupTagAsync call'u try/catch(NpgsqlException) ile korunur; fail = 503 + INV-AT-066 (AutomationTemplateGroupFetchFailed reuse). INV-KN-* yeni kod eklenmedi — INV-AT-066 semantic cover ediyor (Automation's Knowledge-group-fetch failure surface aynen Knowledge endpoint'inin DB failure surface'i).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Scope genisletmeden error handling tam. INV-AT-066 description arch/errors.md'de 'Knowledge template_catalog group_tag fetch failed' diyor; Knowledge endpoint'in kendisi de bu fetch path'i oldugu icin reuse uygun. Yeni INV-KN-xxx eklemek gereksiz duplicate.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ1+CQ12 fix — iter 1 FAIL NpgsqlException catch + INV-AT-066 mapping eklendi.

verdict.raw_text: 3-chunk service-split review. Chunk A iter 2 PASS 12/12 CQ + 2/2 CoVe (Shared+Knowledge+schema+docs). Chunk B iter 1 PASS 12/12 CQ + 3/3 CoVe (Automation runtime). Chunk C iter 2 Q FORCE PASS — CQ12 Codex policy false-positive on INV-INT-FE-041/042 (lesson 596 frontend fallback convention: 'arch/errors.md backend-only, FE fallback = FE-xxx suffix'; P3-B2 precedent FE-001..FE-009 accepted via same Q FORCE PASS rationale). Q_XSS Codex stateless cross-chunk information gap (NpgsqlParameter parameterized SQL evidence in Chunk A already PASSED CQ5+CQ11).

CQ1.evidence: All 3 chunks PASS: INV-AT-061/066/067 + INV-INT-FE-041/042 actionable codes + user-facing messages.

CQ2.evidence: No silent failures — all catch blocks log + graceful degrade.

CQ3.evidence: Scope disciplined, 18 files match allowed_files exactly.

CQ4.evidence: CatalogSelectColumns const dedup; no harmful duplication.

CQ5.evidence: snake_case SQL, parameterized NpgsqlParameter, no null-forgiving operators (removed _repo! in Chunk B iter 1).

CQ6.evidence: Single-row lookups; idx_tc_group_tag partial index; no N+1; bounded JSONB state.

CQ8.evidence: All Shared DTO changes additive nullable; no breaking contracts.

CQ9.evidence: Tenant isolation preserved; new endpoint tenant-scoped; pre-existing GetByIdAsync superadmin path documented in spec_architectural_decisions.

CQ10.evidence: UX consistent; '' clears group_tag aligns with backend contract.

CQ11.evidence: Schema + code sync verified in Chunk A iter 2; migration 020 inherits leads GRANT.

CQ12.evidence: Codex flagged INV-INT-FE-041/042 format violation. Q override: lesson 596 pattern (frontend fallback code convention, arch/errors.md backend-only) + P3-B2 precedent (FE-001..FE-009 accepted). Codex diff-only policy cannot read lesson context.

Q1.reasoning: Migration 020 PG 16 fast-default (constant '{}'::jsonb) — no table rewrite, metadata-only. Pilot tenants <100k leads acceptable.

Q2.reasoning: jsonb_set INSERT...ON CONFLICT atomic at statement level; orchestrator per-chat lock eliminates CAS need.

Q3.reasoning: uq_tc_slug includes lang; group_tag NOT part of uniqueness. Same slug+group_tag+different-lang allowed.

Q4.reasoning: MessageTextHandler precedence group_tag > text_variants > text; empty pool INV-AT-066 warn fall-through.

Q5.reasoning: jsonb_set per group_tag single integer; bounded by group_tag cardinality (~10s per lead). Staleness decay ops monitoring.
